elements.name: Echoing Soul
elements.desc:
You have a supernatural connection to the spirits of the dead. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Whispers of the Dead. When you make an ability check, you can call on the spirits to guide you. You can add a d4 to the roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Haunted. When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, the spirits distract you. You must reroll the die and use the new roll.

elements.name: Gathered Whispers
elements.desc:
You can hear the whispers of nearby spirits. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Spirit Sense. You can cast the Detect Thoughts spell with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you gain this feat).

elements.name: Living Shadow
elements.desc:
Your shadow is not your own. It moves on its own, acting as a conduit for dark magic. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Shadow Stealth. While in dim light or darkness, you can use your bonus action to meld with your shadow, becoming invisible until the start of your next turn. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
Shadow Strike. Your shadow can lash out at your enemies. When you hit with a weapon attack, you can choose to deal an extra 1d6 psychic damage. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Mist Walker
elements.desc:
You have a connection to the Mists of Ravenloft, allowing you to slip through the cracks of reality. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Misty Escape. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
Mistsight. You can see through fog and mist as if it were clear air, up to a range of 60 feet.

elements.name: Second Skin
elements.desc:
You have been physically altered by dark forces, gaining a permanent, disturbing change. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Natural Armor. Your skin hardens, granting you a base AC of 13 + your Dexterity modifier when you aren't wearing armor.
Hideous Appearance. You have advantage on Intimidation checks, but you have disadvantage on Persuasion checks against creatures that can see you.

elements.name: Symbiotic Being
elements.desc:
You share your body with a parasitic or symbiotic entity. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Symbiotic Resilience. You have advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.
Telepathic Link. You can communicate telepathically with the entity, and you can use an action to let the entity speak through you. The entity knows whatever you know.

elements.name: Touch of Death
elements.desc:
Your touch drains the life from others. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Chill Touch. You learn the Chill Touch cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you gain this feat).
Life Drain. When you cast a necromancy spell that deals damage, you can choose to regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Watchers
elements.desc:
You are constantly watched by unseen eyes, but their attention grants you insight. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Paranoia. You can't be surprised while you are conscious.
Unseen Guidance. When you make an ability check, you can call on your unseen watchers to guide you. You can add a d6 to the roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
